people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Ivvah
people.line: City conquered by Assyria, people resettled in Samaria.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

people.name: Sepharvaim
people.line: City of origin for people resettled in Samaria
